summary.headline: Judgment of a Diurnal Nativity
summary.text: Astrological judgment of a diurnal nativity with Cancer ascending, listing planetary positions and the Part of Fortune. The Sun’s triplicity lords, exaltation, midheaven placement, conjunctions, and the Moon’s relation to Jupiter are used to predict prosperity from midlife through old age.
